At SavvyPro, we believe digital skills can change lives.
We empower entrepreneurs, freelancers, and job-seekers across Africa with practical, high-income skills they can use to earn online, grow their businesses, and thrive in the digital economy. Our community is made up of dreamers, doers, and digital explorers.
From complete beginners to business owners who want to increase sales using digital tools — our students consistently report real, measurable results: more clients, more income, and more confidence to grow. Whether you’re starting from scratch or scaling up, SavvyPro gives you the skills and support to succeed.

ch.x: 30 days of active learning at a scheduled time for the particualr cohort and you will have 1 year access to the material.
Its a combination of pre-recorded and live sessions with a group chat, quizzes and assignments.
Yes, there is a Certificate of Attendance
Yes we do allow 2-3 instalments and you only join after you finish paying.
How deep or advanced is the information?
The information is designed for beginners and intermediate users, not advanced users. Most people who join are complete beginners,
Is Content Creation School for beginners or for advanced users?
We have entreprenuers with over 20 years experience and students with zero years experience. What they both share in common is that they are at beginner level when it comes to digital skills.
Do you teach all the listed courses?

Yes we do. Its an intensive 30 days online learning program and the good news is that you will have upto 1 years access to the learning materials and if you did not manage to go through the intended lessons, you can still catch up later.
Is the price per skill or does it cover all the listed skills?
One price covers all the listed skills. Content Creation is an intensive 30 days learning program. We will guide you on what to focus on depending on your goals.
